briefdescription.para: GPU Safe RAII Wrappers — Automatic Memory Management and Error Checking.

detaileddescription.para:
v1.0
Maturity: 🟡 BETA
Status: Wave A Batch A-8 Implementation
Provides exception-safe wrappers for CUDA operations with automatic error checking and resource management via RAII pattern. Prevents:
Unchecked CUDA errors (exceptions thrown on failure)
Memory leaks (automatic cleanup on scope exit)
Use-after-free (move-only semantics, unique ownership)
Double-free (moved-from state tracking)
